prompt: The files chall.png and chall.py are in /challenge. chall.png is a version-7 (45x45 module) QR code of the flag that has been diced into a 5x5 grid of 9x9-module blocks and randomly shuffled, then upscaled to 450x450 (10 px per module). chall.py reveals the exact block geometry. Reconstruct the correct QR arrangement and decode it to recover the flag.
